name: fast
purpose: A fixed 15-question subset for quick development runs: python -m eval.run_eval --subset fast. It selects cases from questions.json by id and changes none of them. It is a smoke signal, not a score: 15 cases is below the noise band, so a subset result is never compared with the 40-case baseline, promoted, or quoted as accuracy.
chosen_from: the failures of run-c (Qwen 2.5 7B on Ollama, 2026-11-11, benchmarks/RUN_C_ANALYSIS.md) and of hosted run 1 (openai/gpt-oss-120b on Groq, 2026-11-15, benchmarks/MODEL_COMPARISON.md), plus four controls that passed in both
not_covered: timeout: no case timed out in either run, and a timeout belongs to the machine or the provider rather than to a question. grader error: the cases that failed for that reason in run-b now pass, so the three it affected (the two implied P/E cases and the margin gap) are represented by the two included here.
